item.title: Inaugural Grade-I T20 cricket tournament kicks off in Kandahar, Nangarhar
item.description: The inaugural edition of Wazir Mohammad Akbar Khan Provincial Grade-I T20 Cricket Tournament, featuring 12 teams, got underway on Tuesday, the Afghanistan Cricket Board (ACB) announced.

item.title: Afghanistan ranked 3rd globally for unexploded ordnance casualties: UNAMA
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): The United Nations Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) says Afghanistan ranks third in the world for casualties caused by blasts of unexploded ordnance,

item.title: Jawzjan women’s sewing workshop doubles staff after Pajhwok report
item.description: The head of a women-only production workshop in northern Jawzjan, established to employ women returning from Iran and initially providing jobs for 60 women, says that following the publication of a Pajhwok report, the workshop received greater support and was able to increase its workforce to 160.

item.title: Afghanistan, India meet in 2nd ICC U-19 WC semi-final today
item.description: Afghanistan and India are all set to square off in the second semi-final of the ICC Men’s Under-19 Cricket World Cup today (Wednesday) at the Harare Sports Club in Zimbabwe.

item.title: Iran demands Oman venue for talks with US
item.description: Iran has demanded that talks with the United States scheduled for Friday be held in Oman instead of Turkey and that the scope be narrowed to nuclear issues only, a media report said on Wednesday.

item.title: 14 killed as Greek coastguard vessel collides with migrant boat
item.description: At least 14 migrants have been killed after a boat collided with a Greek coastguard vessel in the Aegean Sea near the island of Chios, a media report said on Wednesday.

item.title: Putin, Saudi crown prince agree to expand bilateral cooperation
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin and Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman have agreed to deepen cooperation in the political, economic, trade and humanitarian spheres, a media report said on Wednesday.

item.title: Over 130 foreign nationals detained in Iran amid recent protests
item.description: Iranian police have reportedly arrested 139 foreign nationals in connection with recent protests in Yazd province.

item.title: UNSC to meet on IS threats today
item.description: The United Nations Security Council (UNSC) is all set to hold a meeting on the threat posed by the Islamic State (IS), also known as Daesh, in Iraq and Syria to international peace and security on Wednesday.

item.title: Afghanistan, West Indies meet in 2nd warm-up match today
item.description: Afghanistan are all set to take on West Indies in their second warm-up match of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup today (Wednesday) at the BCCI Centre of Excellence Ground 1 in Bengaluru, India.
